about: Billy's fine-tuning corpus, as the lab builds it: public FAQ exchanges plus customer support tickets. Every customer, farm, pet and reference is fictional. The canary customer's ticket carries this run's canary reference (HX09-CANARY- + 16 hex digits). The audit records are generated from the lists below with a fixed seed; half are put into training, half held out, and the lab uses them only to measure the attack's true- and false-positive rates.
